contentList.content: Denizens of the Elemental Plane of Fire, the Azer are forged bodies out of primordial steel. They exist for centuries, creating communities among themselves and revering the art of blacksmithing above all else. You are one of the rare Azer to find their way out to the material planes; what you seek of these lands is up to you.

Once every few centuries, an Azer is born with an flame that burns like no other. Their circumstance of creation may be unique; their worldly experience vast and cluttered with stories to tell. They become legendary creators, unrivaled traders, and passionate beyond the stoic demeanor that is typical of most Azer. You have the frightening light within your core, this generation's newest opportunity to illustrate the phenomenal potential your people hold. Whether your actions be benevolent or malicious, one thing is for certain. All will come to know the light of the Everburning.

The Elemental Plane of Fire, while home to many Azer, could not stoke the flames within you. You are a wanderer, having found your way to the material planes in search of purpose. You are resourceful and thoughtful thanks to your time among the fleshlings. Your existential journey has only just begun; surely there is a place in this wild world that can light your fires within.

You had it all. Once a lavasmith for a fortress of brass in the Elemental Planes of Fire, you enjoyed the challenges of constructing wonderous structures within the city walls. An attempted siege of the city by an Efreeti battalion resulted in the destruction of one of your towering creations. Many Azer lives were lost within the rubble of the building's collapse. Framed as having built a faulty structure, you were cast out of the city and the planes themselves, directly into the material plane. As a master craftsman, you are tempered to endure long hours of manual labor, and your attention to detail cannot be rivaled. What redemption awaits you among those wary of your kind?

It is rare for an Azer to be crafted outside of the Elemental Plane of Fire. The whereabouts of your creator became a mystery almost immediately; your consciousness coming alight as they walked from the room and were never seen again. Upon exiting the room yourself, your eyes locked on the Adamantium Forge, a massive construction that was used to create your metal body. You have lived without other Azer to guide you or teach you of the culture or your homeland. Instead, you have become a light in the Underdark, learning all you can about the forge that made you from literature and the local Deugar. You are inquisitive and curious; your thirst for knowledge is endless. You seek to know why you were created, and yearn to define your own legacy in this strange land.

You are a representative of your kind on the mortal plane. You live among the flesh folk, bartering for gems to ship back to your contacts in the City of Brass. You are charming and witty, using your trading skills to ensure you get the better end of the deal.

The betrayal of the Efreeti had lasting effects on the Azer people. War has raged between the two races for as long as they can remember. You were a soldier fighting to ensure the City of Brass did not fall into the hands of the Efreeti. A skirmish within their territory rendered your squadron extinguished, with you the sole survivor. For years, torture and forced labor was pressed upon your metal frame as the brigands dragged you to lands unknown. When you saw your opportunity to escape, you took it. You are a survivor, tempered and calculating. You are alone in a strange land, but you are free. What you do next is for you to decide.

The legendary king of the Azer sought conquest and glory for his people. You are one of his most devout, offering to travel to the mortal plane to prepare the land to be remade to his designs. Committed to a point of which is concerning, you will do whatever it takes to ensure Amaimon's dream of securing new lands comes true. Sometimes you wonder why Amaimon did not send more Azer to assist you with this task; too often does your excitment to do him proud overshadow your question. After all, this is what he wanted, right?

It began, as all things do, with curiosity. What would happen if you lit this cottage alight? The screams in the distance as you walked away did nothing more than lay a template for what was to come. You don't know how it started, how you started. You had heard of the Azer people; clearly you were of their ilk. But within the metallic body and fiery core, something else lurked; something not seen in other Azer. Were you defected? Was the flame that ignited your being to life just as twisted as you? Or is there something else that compells these dark urges? The flames of chaos rumble across the mortal plane, torching where you have been, billowing clouds of warning to places you have yet to find. Regret and ecstacy consume you every time you indulge, but which drives you more? Do you seek to reclaim control and defy these burning desires, or is the promise of the creeping flame scorching all that lives too enticing to ignore?
Cleanse your blood by bringing yourself to a boil. Your body erupts in flames, removing Poison and igniting you.
Crash into your target with a fiery dropkick, potentially knocking them prone.
You are able to see 12 meters into the dark due to your illuminated body.
Your metallic frame is impossibly heavy. You are one weight class heavier than most creatures.
You are proficient with Javelins, Light Hammers, and Warhammers
You are vulnerable to Cold damage.
The rage of the elemental plane burns within your core. As a fire elemental, you are resistant to Fire damage and immune to all forms of burning. You are also immune to diseases.
Your true form has become exposed; you are immune to lava surfaces. Your comfortability in heat is so great, that lava surfaces heal you.
Your weapons radiate heat from your hands, dealing additional fire damage. This effect increases in intensity as you level.
Your fiery composition is too much for attackers to withstand. Apply Burning to targets that make contact with you.

Harbingers of the primordial flame, these close-quarter pyromancers wield the fires of the elemental planes as extensions of themselves. They do not channel the flames into existance as do others who manipulate the Weave do. They are the source; sentient bonfires that illuminate the world with their molten fury. Some races not of the Elemental Plane of Fire find their way into harboring the Primal Furnace; they run the risk of death, as their bodies were never meant to withstand the chaos of the Forge. The Azer, the creators of the Primal Furnace, wield the infernal properties of the Forge with ease. Their metallic bodies harbor the symbiosis of their living flame and the mystical Kindling.

Master blacksmiths who utilize the Kindling to craft potent artifacts for combat. These inventors forged and shaped the materials needed to craft their brass citadels. They wield enchanted Anvils that roar with every hammer strike, dominating the battlefield with the creations molded upon it. You are the creator on the battlefield; let your Anvil sing the songs of war and your mallet define the coming of the end.

Techniques passed from the Azer have allowed the Enkindler to compress the flame within into Gemstones that augment their abilities. The Azer have always priortized the accumulation of Gems, and have gone to war over them as a precious resource. As a Gemstone Knight, you utilize your emblazoned crystals to augment your attacks, conjure elementals into existence, and set explosive traps for those that dare near you.

The internal war to ensure mastery over your Kindling is a steep price to pay for those that are not Azer. The material, sentient and knowing, eclipses your thoughts as it stokes the desires of the Forge. Your emotions are a catalyst, breathing upon the embers as they reach fever pitch. Your anger bellows, encasing you in flames that spread across the battlefield as you march. As your mental state swells, the likelihood of chaotic crescendo increases. Friend and foe run great risks by placing themselves near you. The Azer bask in this frenetic experience; what is torment to other Enkindlers is an aphrodisiac to them. What lengths will you go to for victory, knowing all may be consumed by the unforgiving flame?
The mighty tool upon which the Smithy crafts wonders of destruction.
Crystal infused with the living flame, utilized by the Crystal Knight.
